note: Weekday bank holidays, including substitute days, per region. Used to avoid projecting dates into a holiday week (the calendar feed) and to tell expected holiday shifts from round changes (change detection). Only regions marked verified are used by the code. To verify a region, check every date against the official page named in its source, then set verified to true. The dates run to the end of 2027: add the next years before then (a test reminds us).

england-and-wales.source: GOV.UK UK bank holidays, and the Privy Council proclamation for 2027 (https://www.gov.uk/bank-holidays)

scotland.source: Draft, to check against https://www.gov.scot/publications/bank-holidays/. 4 January 2027 (in place of Saturday 2 January) and 31 May 2027 are confirmed by the Privy Council proclamation; the rest are the usual pattern (first Monday in August, 30 November St Andrew's Day) and are unconfirmed. A one-off 15 June 2026 holiday was mentioned by one source and is not included.

northern-ireland.source: Draft, to check against https://www.nidirect.gov.uk/articles/bank-holidays. 12 July 2027 is confirmed by the Privy Council proclamation and several 2026 dates by a Northern Ireland health circular; the other 2027 dates are the usual pattern and are unconfirmed.
